item.title: Trump census plan may alter voting maps and remove race questions
item.description: The Trump administration's renewed effort to change how the U.S. population is counted could affect congressional apportionment in future elections.

item.title: Living in an AI twilight zone
item.description: Two contradictory realities coexist: most people find AI only modestly useful, akin to a smarter Google search, while many building AI see something more.

item.title: Trump repeats promise of $5,000 checks
item.description: President Trump is promising $5,000 checks to every adult U.S. citizen if Republicans keep control of Congress in the upcoming midterm election.

item.title: Governments use Claude to automate spying
item.description: State-run surveillance operations worldwide are using Claude to streamline their work, Anthropic said in a threat report released Thursday.
